description.html: This 30x30x55 cm terrarium (49.5 L) comes with a handmade 3D background that imitates natural relief, such as rock or bark. The background adds depth to the space and lets animals climb, hide and feel more secure.

The vertical orientation with 55 cm of height makes this terrarium suitable for arboreal species, animals that live in tree canopies and on trunks in the wild. Add branches, cork and artificial plants to recreate a vertical habitat. The ventilation system is designed for constant airflow that prevents overheating and trapped moisture.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
